function.description: Apply a unified-diff patch to one file: each hunk applies where its context matches nearest its @@ line (exact, then whitespace-tolerant); fails loudly if the context matches nowhere or ambiguously
function.name: coding_apply_patch

file_path.description: Path to the file to patch (relative to the workspace, or absolute within it)

patch.description: Unified diff for this one file (@@ hunks). Context/removed lines must match exactly.
